meta.purpose: Cross-lingual retrieval gate. The corpus is Vietnamese and English only, so every ZH / JA / KO case is a genuine cross-language test: can a question in one script reach a document written in another? The same six intents are asked in five languages, so a per-language score isolates the language rather than the topic.
meta.note: Labels are identical across the language variants of an intent — the underlying truth does not change with the language of the question. A language that scores far below Vietnamese is a retrieval gap, not a corpus gap.
